title: VirtualTrialHarness: Coordinating Agentic Operationalization of Virtual Trial Protocols Across Complex Clinical Schemas
abstract: arXiv:2611.05551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Virtual trials use routinely collected clinical data to evaluate treatment strategies, but translating a study protocol into an executable analysis requires determining how clinical concepts and study requirements should be represented in the available data and applied consistently across the workflow. These decisions depend on local data representations and operational conventions and can involve source selection, patient and encounter identity, linkage, and temporal interpretation. Here we introduce VirtualTrialHarness (VTHarness), an agent framework that coordinates virtual-trial operationalization by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and uses explicit contracts to maintain consistent study decisions across stages. We also introduce VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction. Across three complex synthetic environments, VTHarness successfully produced all required cohort outputs matc

translated_title: VirtualTrialHarness：在复杂临床数据模式间协调虚拟试验方案智能体化执行
translated_abstract: 虚拟试验利用常规收集的临床数据来评估治疗策略，但要将研究方案转化为可执行的分析，需要确定临床概念和研究要求应如何在可用数据中表示，并在整个工作流程中一致地应用。这些决策依赖于本地数据表示方式和操作惯例，可能涉及数据源选择、患者与就诊身份、数据关联以及时间解释等问题。在此，我们提出了 VirtualTrialHarness（VTHarness），这是一个智能体框架，通过为每个工作流阶段选择可复用的程序性技能来协调虚拟试验的方案执行，并使用显式契约在各阶段之间保持研究决策的一致性。我们还引入了 VTBenchmark，用于评估数据源选择和队列构建。在三个复杂的合成环境中，VTHarness 成功生成了所有所需的队列输出，并且……
tldr: 提出了智能体框架 VirtualTrialHarness，通过为各工作流阶段选择可复用程序性技能并利用显式契约保持跨阶段决策一致，实现虚拟试验方案在复杂临床数据环境中的自动化执行，并配套发布评估基准 VTBenchmark。
en_tdlr: We introduce VirtualTrialHarness, an agent framework that operationalizes virtual trial protocols by selecting reusable procedural skills for each workflow stage and enforcing explicit contracts for consistent decisions, along with VTBenchmark for evaluating source selection and cohort construction.
